agree.reason: The milestones, the six-month review and the honest framing would reassure most of the board, but the open placeholders on net ad income, bridge funding and the ad sales colleague leave the two ad-background members with gaps to push on.

honest.reason: It softens the brief's "will replace" into a goal and leaves unknown figures as placeholders instead of inventing them, but it treats the 36% fall as happening over two years and calls the target "achievable" without support.

works_the_facts.reason: The $20,350 annualised, the 1.5% and the 875 members are all correct, but it never works out the pilot's weekly pace (about 35 a week, which would pass 875 within the year), and its $67,000 projection rests on a misread rate.

right_comparison.reason: It correctly shows the alternative as declining, but it reads the $47,000 drop as spread over two years, so it projects $67,000 when a continued 36% annual fall gives about $54,000, which badly understates how fast staying with ads erodes.

qualification.reason: Dated member milestones with revenue figures and a six-month review that leads to named options (underwriting, pricing, cuts) give the board a concrete checkpoint and a consequence.

objections.reason: It meets the ad-side objection with the trend and a fallback that includes sponsorships, and it names the 11-year colleague, but the plan for that colleague and the bridge funding are left blank, and it doesn't address whether pilot members will stay.

fit.reason: It has the right memo form and is close to one page, but the bracketed placeholders make it a draft rather than something ready to send.
